title: Quality getting worse over time and not worth the money any more
text: My daughter subscribed for a year and she enjoyed receiving a new country every month and kept her excited. However, for the past few months the materials we received seem to get to a downhill, a thin envelop with a few paper and small gadget and one food recipe. it's definitely not worth the $20 cost and my daughter didn't learn much. I'm cancelling the subscription and will try out kiwi box atlas which looks similar but comes with a lot more crafting materials.
label: neutral
